subject: art-design
title: Warm, Cool & Mood
welcome_lead: Reds glow, blues calm — colour controls mood.
meta_desc: KS3 colour theory: warm vs cool, emotional effects.
final_note: Choose colour temperature to set the mood.

concepts.def: Whether a colour feels warm or cool.
How pure or strong a colour is.

walkthroughs.body_html: Warm colours like red and orange remind us of fire and sun. They feel energetic, urgent or cosy. They appear to come forward in a picture.
Cool colours like blue and green remind us of sky, ice, water. They feel calm, sad, or distant. They appear to recede backwards.
A mostly cool painting with one warm accent draws the eye. Picasso's Blue Period (1901-1904) used cool blues to show sadness. Choose temperature on purpose.
